# Naomi Kajaira Kilima

> Advocate of the High Court of Kenya specialising in Family, Criminal, Human Rights, Company, and Conveyancing Law, with a focus on women’s and children’s rights. Partner at Agoi Kilima & Company Advocates in Nairobi.

Consultations are held in chambers at View Park Towers, Nairobi, or via Google Meet. English is the language of instruction. East Africa Time is UTC+3 and does not use daylight saving.

## Practice

- Family and child law: custody, guardianship, adoption, and estate planning under the Children Act
- Alternative dispute resolution, including mediation by Google Meet
- Commercial and civil litigation: contracts, compliance, and proceedings in Kenya
- Human rights and public interest law: compliance, legal aid, and constitutional rights

Instructions are accepted in family, criminal, human rights, company, and conveyancing matters, with a focus on women’s and children’s rights. Immigration, tax, and the law of another jurisdiction fall outside this practice.

## How an instruction begins

A client relationship arises only when the firm confirms the engagement. The public diary shows available hours only and does not display client names. Do not send confidential information through the website form.

## Credentials

- Bachelor of Laws (LLB), Moi University
- Postgraduate Diploma in Law, Kenya School of Law
- Certified Mediator, Law Mediation Training Institute of East Africa
- Advocate of the High Court of Kenya
- Member, Law Society of Kenya
